sources.name: Guinness World Records
sources.text: "Most career goals (football)", record page, read 30 October 2026: 1,279 goals by Pelé "from 7 Sep 1956 to 1 Oct 1977 in 1,363 games"; best year 1959 "with 126"; the Milésimo on 19 Nov 1969 at the Maracanã; "He later added two more goals in special appearances." The page does not say what the 1,363 games include. Pelé is still the listed holder.

sources.name: Guinness World Records
sources.text: "Pelé, Brazilian football legend, dies at 82", 29 December 2022: "during a playing career which stretched from 7 Sep 1956 to 1 Oct 1977, Pelé scored 1,283 goals"; "In 2013, Pelé was presented with his Guinness World Records certificates for Most Career Goals and Most World Cup Winners' Medals."

sources.name: CONMEBOL
sources.text: "80 años de Pelé: ¡Sigue siendo el Rey!", 23 October 2020: "Un total de 1363 partidos oficiales disputados, 1281 goles convertidos y 24 títulos de clubes"; credit line "Datos: OPTA".

sources.name: FIFA
sources.text: "Records being hunted in 2020", 1 January 2020: table row "Pele Santos 643 659 0.98" (goals, matches, ratio), the record for goals for 1 club.

sources.name: FIFA
sources.text: "Behind the World Cup record: Pele", 19 June 2020: "12 of his record 77 Brazil goals" and "1,000-plus strikes overall". Supports what this FIFA page says; no FIFA page read for this exhibit gives an exact career total.

sources.name: FIFA
sources.text: "Happy 80th birthday to 'The King'", 23 October 2020: "Pele extraordinarily scored 127 goals for Santos in one calendar year: 1959."

sources.name: FC Barcelona
sources.text: "Barça 2-2 Valencia: Points shared at Camp Nou", 19 December 2020, embedding the club's tweet of the same day: "Leo #Messi equals @Pele as the all time top goalscorer for one club WITH 643 goals!"

sources.name: FC Barcelona
sources.text: "Leo Messi surpasses Pelé as highest goalscorer ever for a single club", 22 December 2020: "After scoring against Valladolid he has moved past the legendary Pelé"; "644 goals, all wearing an FC Barcelona shirt, across 17 seasons and 749 games"; "That surpasses the 643 goals that the Brazilian scored for Santos".

sources.name: Santos FC
sources.text: Statement of 26 December 2020, signed by Fernando Ribeiro of Assophis (Associação dos Pesquisadores e Historiadores do Santos FC). The club's site refuses scripts; the text was read through Gazeta Esportiva's reproduction, below. Supports: "Pelé marcou 1.091 gols pelo Santos."; 643 in competitions and 448 goals in friendlies "relegados ao ostracismo"; "Os números são absolutos."; the Transvaal and Bernabéu sentence; official kits, official rules and a match report; more than 1,000 days touring; skipping the 1967 Copa Libertadores despite qualifying; Pelé's congratulations to Messi, quoted in the statement. Translations are this site's.

sources.name: Gazeta Esportiva
sources.text: "Santos publica texto para defender Pelé após "recorde" de Messi: "Números são absolutos"", 26 December 2020: reproduces the text of Santos's statement, introduced as "publicado pelo Santos e assinado por Fernando Ribeiro, da Associação dos Pesquisadores e Historiadores do Santos FC (Assophis)".

sources.name: RSSSF (Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation)
sources.text: "Prolific Scorers Data", compiled by Vladimir Kolos, last updated 3 August 2026: official matches, Pelé 11th with 778 goals in 851 matches; the legend of what official includes, among it "all selections: A, B, Ol, U, league, armee, senior, regional, city, etc."; all matches, Pelé 8th with 1,324 in 1,413; official matches at the top level, a list marked "NB: preliminary list", Pelé 3rd with 770; all matches at the top level, also preliminary, "containing: 1. Official goals in top level; 2. All international friendlies; 3. National friendlies against top-league teams; tournaments; select matches", Pelé 1st with "Pele 770 396 108 1274"; 1 team, "Pele 643 Santos" (official) and "Pele 1089 Santos" (all); 1 season, "Pele 1959 128 107" (all matches) and "Pele 1959 120 101" (all matches, top level).

sources.name: RSSSF (Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation)
sources.text: "Prolific Scorers Data - Pelé - Additional Data", last updated 25 August 2024: by team, FC Santos official 644 goals in 666 matches and 1,093 in 1,117 in total; career totals official 778 in 851, all 1,324 in 1,413.

sources.name: Brazil, Câmara dos Deputados
sources.text: Lei nº 14.909, de 1º de julho de 2024, "Institui o Dia do Rei Pelé." Art. 1º: the day is celebrated annually on 19 November, "data em que marcou seu milésimo gol, no ano de 1969".
